notes.title: 【Known Issue】Mac version unable to use Steam Cloud Save
notes.content: [p]Dear players,[/p][p]We’ve identified a problem where [b]Steam Cloud Save is currently not working on the Mac version[/b] of the game. This means your progress [b]won’t sync[/b] to the cloud and may be lost if switching devices.[/p][p]We have located the issue and are [b]actively working on a fix[/b]. In the meantime, we recommend:[/p][list][*][p][b]Avoid switching devices[/b] while playing on Mac.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Manually back up your save files[/b] regularly.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll post an update as soon as the issue is resolved. Thank you for your patience and support![/p][p]—The [i]This Month’s Stay: Hotel Tycoon[/i] Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Now Available: Check In to Your Hotel Empire!
notes.content: [p][b]"Stay&Stack: Hotel Operation"[/b] is now officially available on Steam![/p][p]In this turn-based simulation game, you’ll build your own hotel empire from the ground up. Set room prices, customize comfort levels, attract tourists and business travelers, and watch your humble inn evolve into a luxury destination. Strategic placement and smart investments are the keys to becoming a top hotel magnate![/p][p]Are you ready to take on this month’s management challenge?[/p]
